latest_release.body:
**v1.5.0: Multiple build engines, hot framework loading, and Dark Glass / 多构建引擎、游戏框架热加载与暗色液态玻璃**

## English

**Highlights**

1. **Multi-engine workbench (#1368, #1370, #1372, #1374, #1405, #1455, #1473, #1474, #1498)**: Switch engines in one click from the top of `Builds` or `Settings` between `nxnative`, self-updating `nxkit 0.10.3 (Beta)` with Ed25519 signature verification, and turnkey `MacNativeGames` guarded to its 5 maintained titles (`MNG` badges) for first-party Mac play, with `S2Arm` behind `NX2APPLE_ENABLE_S2ARM=1`.
2. **Faster rebuilds and incremental refresh (#1296, #1299, #1322, #1323, #1483)**: Version 1.5.0 builds persist `build-seeds` caches so most updates run fast batch refreshes in minutes without the original game package or intermediate build directories, isolated from unstarted build drafts.
3. **Install new games without reinstalling the shared shell IPA (#1217, #1305, #1437, #1493, #1495)**: Export signed or unsigned `DmGame.framework` bundles into `Documents/Frameworks`, import a `.p12` sideload certificate on iOS for on-device framework signing (#1493), or hot-push directly on iOS 27 (`glueVersion: 2`), with no shell IPA reinstall required.
4. **Slim shared shell IPA (#1216, #1229, #1270, #1295, #1439)**: `DMMSLTR1` shader trailers and optional bundled payloads move into external `.img` archives so the shared `NX2Apple.ipa` stays a few tens of megabytes for easier sideload signing, paired with foreground `kqueue` `.nxpart` auto-joining (#1481).
5. **Full Shortcuts support (#1395, #1437)**: Built-in 6-step Add to Home Screen guide and an optional Picture-in-Picture walkthrough card support `nx2apple://launch` home screen icons and controller-connect auto-launch shortcuts.
6. **Major Windows build upgrades (#1249, #1253, #1255, #1315, #1317, #1355, #1414, #1447, #1485, #1492, #1499)**: Qt adds a general multi-game `BuildQueue`, expands the Oodle Unicorn emulated heap up to 2 GiB on demand for large shader blocks such as Pokemon Violet, fixes Windows seed adoption paths, `.engine-id` CRLF hashes, and exFAT zero-inode build seed loops (#1456, #1478, #1492, #1499), aligns iOS packager contracts, and improves CET, Defender, and Visual C++ diagnostics.
7. **Background audio mixing (#1300, #1438)**: `DM_AUDIO_MIX` lets music or podcasts keep playing into a game without stopping or lock-free callback crackling, alongside atomic audio teardown and `AudRen` thread draining (#1305, #1314, #1395).
8. **Per-game update version badges (#1296, #1457, #1458, #1486)**: Both Supported Games and hero cards surface the latest NX2Apple version that optimized each game (such as `1.5` across a 102-game catalog with 80 titles updated in `1.5.0`) so players know when to rebuild.
9. **Redesigned launcher UI and artwork pipeline (#1392, #1443, #1457, #1458, #1459, #1467, #1468, #1474, #1484)**: Dark Glass design system backed by design tokens, Liquid Glass reserved for navigation layers, rebuilt two-column console mode, three-tier banner fallback with eShop Switch 2 covers across Mac, iOS, and Qt, and an interactive 16:9 iOS cover cropper.
10. **574-commit engine leap from `ccd834e0` to `99224562186a` (#1226, #1312, #1361, #1448, #1486, #1494)**: Covers over 140 game profiles (208 in the engine tree), unlocks higher frame rates and rendering fixes across major titles, and adds Polish and Thai game language options.

**New**
- **Dark Glass design system and state gallery**: the Mac launcher moves to a single dark palette backed by `design-tokens/tokens.json`, removes light mode branches, keeps Liquid Glass strictly in navigation surfaces, standardizes sheet layouts, and adds `--gallery` (`NX_GALLERY=1`) to inspect every view and failure state locally (#1458, #1459, #1474 by @v0lumehi)
- **Built-first library, single-screen Builds, and redesigned console mode**: playable Mac and iOS builds sort ahead of muted unbuilt titles, Builds returns to a single screen without truncated stage ETAs, opening Builds matches pre-redesign speed,

detail.readme:
**Your Switch games, running on your iPhone.** **Not an emulator. No terminal. A macOS or Windows app does the whole build in a few clicks.** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![Games](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-available-green)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-current-blue)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 Latest highlights - **Multi-engine workbench and Dark Glass UI**: Switch in one click at the top of the Builds page or in Settings between `nxnative`, `nxkit (Beta)` (with Ed25519-verified self-updates and console overlay support via `NXKIT_OVERLAY`), and `MacNativeGames` (guarded for 5 maintained first-party Mac titles), all wrapped in the unified Dark Glass UI and redesigned two-column controller console mode. - **Hot-loaded iOS game frameworks, `.p12` on-device signing, and slim shared IPA**: All your games share a compact shell app of a few tens of megabytes (`DMMSLTR1` shader trailers move into external `.img` archives with foreground `.nxpart` auto-joining). Add or update games by hot-pushing or exporting `DmGame.framework` into `Documents/Frameworks` without reinstalling the shell IPA (sideload users can import a `.p12` certificate in the iOS app for automatic on-device signing), in **10 UI languages**. - **Persistent build seeds and fast batch refresh**: Builds made with `1.5` persist `build-seeds`, so most subsequent engine upgrades finish in minutes via batch refresh without keeping the original game package or `_build` folders, paired with per-game update version badges (such as `1.5`) and three-way missing `.img` recovery. The Windows launcher (`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`) also adds a general multi-game `BuildQueue`, an emulated heap growing up to 2 GiB on demand, and in-app self-update (`NX2Apple.exe`). - **Shortcuts with PiP guide, audio mixing, and controllers**: iPhone and iPad add a built-in 6-step Add to Home Screen wizard with an optional Picture-in-Picture walkthrough card and controller-connect auto-launch, background audio mixing (`DM_AUDIO_MIX`), an interactive `16:9` cover cropper, a visual touch layout editor, split Bluetooth Joy-Con sideways mapping on Mac, and Steam Controller (2026) support. - **208 game profiles, including 19 Switch 2 games**: Pick a Switch 2 game folder or `.nup` file in the Mac or Windows launcher with no `prod.keys` needed, backed by Nintendo eShop banner fallback across Mac, iOS, and Windows. Every release is in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).
--- ## What NX2Apple is NX2Apple runs Nintendo Switch games on your Mac and iPhone from your own game dumps. It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs natively on Apple silicon, and Metal draws it. A Mac app, the launcher, does the build in a few clicks (unpack, rewrite, translate the shaders, pack) and then keeps your games in a library you start with **Play**, the way a Switch does. It is a community fork of **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)**, which does the actual work (the code rewriter, the Horizon host, NVN on Metal and every game's profile). This fork adds the launcher and a short list of patches, and follows nxnative every day. ## Requirements - **An Apple silicon Mac.** The launcher opens on **macOS 13 or later**. Building needs Xcode with the iOS SDK, and NVN games need [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/download/all/?q=Xcode%2027.2) 27.2 (macOS 26.6 or later) unless built with `--allow-other-metal`. Take 27.2 from Apple's download page, not the App Store's newer Xcode. With both installed, give 27.2 a distinct name such as `Xcode-27.2.app`. In **Settings → Tools → Choose Xcode…**, select the copy to use with NX2Apple, including one on an external drive. During first-run setup, click **Set up later** to reach Settings, then **Run setup again** after choosing Xcode. **Use system Xcode** follows the Mac's command-line selection (for example, `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode-27.2.app`). - **Your own game dumps** (NSP or XCI) and **your own `prod.keys`** from your own console. Nothing is bundled, downloaded or looked up for you. The same `prod.keys` opens every one of your Switch games. A current dump covers all retail titles. Switch 2 games (a game folder or `.nup` file) do not need `prod.keys`. - For an iPhone or iPad: iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and a recent device. Older devices are untested. The app carries its own build tools and Python, so no Homebrew and no Python install are needed. Neither the default `nxnative` engine nor the native `nxkit` engine needs .NET; only the S2Arm engine does, and the app installs the .NET SDK for it in one click. The launcher's dependency page checks each requirement and installs what it can with one click. ## Install 1. **Download the app**: `NX2Apple-macOS-arm64.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/releases/latest). Unzip it. 2. **Open it once with right-click, then Open.** The app is not signed with a paid Apple developer certificate, so macOS asks before the first start. After that it opens normally. 3. **Follow the setup.** The launcher fetches the project it builds with (a **Download repository** button on the setup page, a shallow clone into `~/NX2Apple`. If GitHub is slow, the page shows the manual ZIP route), checks the tools above and updates itself later. You never need git. 4. **Build a game.** Pick the game's folder (or its base game, update, DLC and `prod.keys` one by one), choose **This Mac** or **iPhone / iPad**, and press build. The page shows the real stages and the time left, and a stopped build continues where it left off. The **iPhone / iPad** target is one app on the device for all your games. The launcher signs it with Xcode, installs it and copies the game in. It needs a device paired with the Mac. Building by hand from a terminal is in [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). **Updating a game you already built.** Games built with `1.5` persist local build seeds, so when syncing engine improvements you can use **Refresh** or **Batch refresh** to update in minutes without keeping the original NSP/XCI or `_build` folders. When installing a newer update NSP for the game itself, select the game in the library and choose **Rebuild**, keeping the base game selected and picking the new NSP in **Updates & add-on content** in the same output folder. The update can change both game code and data, so the launcher builds the new version and reuses cached work where it can. Your saves stay in their existing folder outside the `.app`, keyed by the game's title ID. Rebuilding or refreshing in the same library keeps that progress. ## The iPhone and iPad app The **iPhone / iPad** target builds one shell app that holds all your games, the way the Mac launcher does. Its library shows each game with its key art. In portrait it is one column with the chosen game at the top. On its side it is a Cover Flow. An iPad shows a grid. - **Add games from the Mac.** Build a game with the **iPhone / iPad** target and the launcher copies it into the app. You can also export a standalone `DmGame.framework` and place it in `Files > On My iPhone > NX2Apple > Frameworks` without reinstalling the shared shell app (sideload users can import their `.p12` certificate in the iOS app's Settings so unsigned frameworks are signed automatically on device). Re-signing and reinstalling the app keeps your game data and saves. - **Play.** Pick a game and tap **Play**. A game that is missing its data, or needs a newer app, says so on its card and offers the fix. - **Settings for each game.** The settings button (or X on a controller) opens that game's launch options. **Reset** puts every choice back to its default. - **Home Screen shortcuts.** Use the built-in 6-step **Add to Home Screen** wizard (with an optional Picture-in-Picture walkthrough card) to create `nx2apple://launch` home screen icons or launch automatically when a controller connects. - **Play with other audio.** Enable **Play with other audio** (`DM_AUDIO_MIX`) so music or podcasts keep playing smoothly alongside your games. - **Change Cover.** Use **Change Cover…** to pick custom artwork and adjust it with the interactive `16:9` pinch-and-pan cropper. - **Controller or keyboard.** The whole app works from a controller: the D-pad and stick move, A picks, B goes back, X opens the settings and Y lists the controllers. A hardware keyboard works the same way. - **Game data folder.** Each game can read its data from a folder you pick in the Files app, for example on an external drive, or from the app's own folder. - **Cloud saves.** Pick an iCloud Drive folder for a game's saves to keep them in step with the Mac. - **Language.** The app follows the system language across all **10 languages** (English, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese). The app needs iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The covers are the eShop banners the Mac launcher caches for your own games. ## How to play **On the Mac**, a finished game appears in the library with its key art. **Play** starts it. **Launch options** (per game, kept across rebuilds) set the frame rate, console mode (docked or handheld), render scale and upscaling, game language, controls and more. What each does is in [docs/settings.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/settings.md). A controller drives the launcher as well as the games. **On the iPhone**, the app shows the same settings before the game starts, tap **Play**. Touch controls come in a 2D and a 3D layout (tap the button at the top centre), and a connected controller (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, MFi) replaces them. [docs/playing.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/playing.md) covers touch, rumble and motion. Short stutters the first time a scene appears are normal: the app compiles graphics for it once and remembers them. The game's data (`romfs.img`) can live on an external drive that the Files app picks. **Game language.** On the Mac, a game that has your Mac's language starts in it: the **Game language** row of Launch options preselects it until you pick another (1.5 also adds Polish and Thai options), and **Reset to tested defaults** goes back to it. A game without your Mac's language, a game built in another language (`LANGUAGE`), and every iPhone build start in the build's language, English by default. For anything the sheet lacks, write an `env.txt` of `KEY=VALUE` lines (for example `DM_LANG=zh-Hans`) in one of two places: `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative//env.txt` wins and survives rebuilds, while `<App>.app/Contents/Resources/dm/env.txt` is the app's own. A Mac app built before the language row existed needs one rebuild to get it. On the iPhone, the same lines go in `Documents/env.txt` (`DM_FPS_TARGET=30` caps the frame rate to save battery, `DM_OPMODE=0` picks handheld mode). That file applies to every game in the shared app. For a line that belongs to one game (a mod's `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`, for example), write it in `Documents/games/<title ID>/env.txt`. Where both files set a key, the game's file wins. A mod is easier: put its folder in `Documents/games/<title ID>/mods/<mod name>/` (the RomFS files in a `romfs/` folder inside it, or in the folder itself). The shell then sets `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY` for that game only. If there are several mods, the one first by name wins where they replace the same file. Where the same key is set twice, the order is: the shell's own settings, the game's `env.txt`, the game's `mods/` folder, the shared `Documents/env.txt`. **Saves and logs.** A Mac game in a library folder keeps its saves and its log beside the app (`log/<title ID>.log`). Otherwise they are in `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative/<title ID>/` and `~/Library/Logs/nxnative/<title ID>.log`. On the iPhone they are in the Files app under the app's name: `save/` and `log.txt` (the previous run is `log.prev.txt`). **Reporting a bug.** A launcher or build problem goes to the [issue forms](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues/new/choose) (build problem, launcher problem). Each asks for your versions and computer, **Settings > Copy diagnostics** and, for a build, the Build log. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) says why. A game that crashes, freezes, runs slowly or looks wrong goes to [seedds/nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/issues). Never attach keys, game files or anything extracted from a game. ## Games 208 games have a profile. Many are reported playable on an iPhone upstream, and most have a profile that has not been tried on a phone yet. A few of them: | | Game | Where it runs | Status | |---|---|---|---| | <img Splatoon Raiders, Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave, Pokémon Pokopia, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment, Mario Kart World, Mario Tennis Fever, Star Fox, Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Kirby Air Riders, Super Mario Bros. Choose the game's folder of files (`base/`, `updates/`, `dlc/`) or its `.nup` file on the Builds page. No `prod.keys` are needed for them. The library marks them **Switch 2**. In addition to Donkey Kong Bananza running on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 edition) has been played through the ending credits on Mac, and Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave has been verified at 60 fps on iPhone. [GAMES.md](GAMES.md#switch-2-games) has the details. ## Limitations - **Only the games with a profile.** A title outside the list needs bring-up work of its own. The place to start is [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/agents/README.md), upstream's guide for another Switch title. - **Big games on an iPhone hit a memory limit.** Without the Increased Memory Limit entitlement iOS gives the app about 3.4 GB, which is not enough for Tears of the Kingdom. The app requests it, and AltStore Classic 2.2+, Impactor and Xcode with a Personal Team keep it. SideStore with a free Apple ID needs a one-time App ID fix, and Sideloadly drops it ([the steps](ENTITLEMENTS.md)). The full measurements are in [GAMES.md](GAMES.md#verified-on). - **Unsigned launcher.** The launcher is not signed for you, so you sideload it. The iPhone app is signed by Xcode with your own team when the launcher installs it. - **Your own files.** No game data, firmware or keys are included or downloaded. - **Older shard archives are not read any more.** The first iPhone builds packed Tears of the Kingdom into a RomFS shard archive (`romfs.idx`), whereas builds now write a single `romfs.img`. An iPhone that still holds an old archive needs the game data sent again once, as a `romfs.img` through the launcher. ## For developers - **Build from source:** [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). **Report or fix something:** [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). - **Where help is wanted:** the [milestones](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/milestones) are the plan, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#where-we-would-love-help) says how to take an issue from one. - **We are looking for one or two more developers.** There is a lot to do. If you want to join us, take an open issue from a milestone and send a well made pull request. People who deliver good work, again and again, are asked to help with reviews and triage. - **What this fork changes in upstream:** the engine (`dm/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`, `ref/`) is not committed here. It is nxnative at a pinned commit (`.upstream-ref`) plus a queue of patches, each saying why the fork carries it, and `python3 tools/engine.py sync` builds it into `engine/`. [patches/README.md](patches/README.md) explains it, and `python3 tools/engine.py status` lists what is carried. A daily job moves the pin and opens a pull request, or an issue naming the patch that no longer fits. The links to the engine's documents in this README point at nxnative at the pinned commit. - **Another Switch game:** [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/agents/README.md) (extraction, binary survey, bring-up). - **Release history:** [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Credits **Community contributors** — this project's code is not one maintainer's output: - **[v0lumehi](https://github.com/v0lumehi)** — **the Mac front end's launcher** (PR [#27](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/27), 40 files): a game library with key art, per-game launch options, a real progress stream, and a Stop that ends the whole build's process group. The Mac app went from "a build form" to the first version of a launcher that opens like a Switch. - **[m1guelpf](https://github.com/m1guelpf)** (Miguel Piedrafita) — two HLE fixes (PRs [#24](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/24) and [#26](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/26)): the missing `EnableAlbumImageTakenNotification` and `CreateWithAdjustableSystemClock` entries plus their snapshot type byte — each would have read a null in games that call them, and each came with a test. Want on this list? [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md#helping-with-games) says how to start — reports with a full log and fixes with a test move fastest. **Community projects** — maintained by their authors, outside this repository: - **[widmonstertony/nxnative](https://github.com/widmonstertony/nxnative)** (`ios16-pokemon-za-port` branch) — iOS/iPadOS 16.1–17 and tvOS compatibility, with a legacy Metal renderer path, tested on an A10X iPad and an M2 iPad. For devices this fork's releases do not support. All of the engine work is other people's. This repository adds the launcher and the patch queue on top: - **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** (MIT) — the native-execution toolchain this repository is built from: the NSO rewriter, the Horizon host layer, NVN-on-Metal, the per-game profiles and the iOS shell. - **[d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile)** (MIT) — the original native-execution approach that nxnative grew out of. - **Ryujinx** (MIT) — the shader translator that turns Maxwell shaders into SPIR-V. - **[Atmosphère](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere)** — the reference for Horizon's synchronization semantics. - **[LibHac](https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibHac)** — reads NSPs and layers updates in `nx_extract`. - **[SPIRV-Cross](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross)** — SPIR-V to Metal Shading Language. - **yuzu**, **deko3d**, **libvpx**, **stb_vorbis**, **libdeflate** — see upstream's acknowledgement list for what each contributes. `dm/third_party` ships other projects with their licenses ([list](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/dm/third_party/README.md)). ## Legal **What this project is.** A build tool for games you already own. It reads dumps you made of your own cartridges and purchases, on your own machine, and produces a package for your own device. Nothing in this repository, in the app, or in any release contains or distributes Nintendo's code, art, text, data, shaders, firmware, keys or any other copyrighted material. **What it cannot do.** The pipeline has no source of games or keys: it requires the user's own `prod.keys` and their own NSP/XCI dumps, and it talks to no server. It does not bypass, strip or redistribute any protection — LibHac opens the user's own dumps with the user's own keys, the same operation a console performs on a cartridge. **Trademarks.** Not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Nintendo. "Nintendo Switch" and game titles are trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd., and all other trademarks belong to their respective owners. **Your responsibility.** Laws on making a personal backup copy differ by country, and some places do not allow it at all. You are responsible for knowing and following the law where you live, and for never distributing game files, keys or the packages built from them — the project's outputs are for personal use on your own hardware only. If you enjoy a game, buy it. **Takedowns.** If you believe anything in this repository infringes your rights, open an issue or contact the maintainer directly. **你的 Switch 游戏，跑在你的 iPhone 上。** **不是模拟器。不用命令行。一个 macOS 或 Windows App 点几下就把整个构建做完。** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![游戏](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-current-blue)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-available-green)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 最近重点更新 - **多构建引擎工作台与暗色液态玻璃界面**：在构建页顶部或设置中一键切换 `nxnative`、支持 Ed25519 验签自更新与主机模式内嵌叠加（`NXKIT_OVERLAY`）的 `nxkit (Beta)`，以及面向 5 款维护第一方大作 Mac 游玩的 `MacNativeGames`，全系采用统一 Dark Glass 界面与重制版双栏手柄主机模式 - **iOS 游戏框架热加载、`.p12` 本机自签与瘦身共享壳**：所有游戏共用数十 MB 瘦身壳应用（`DMMSLTR1` 着色器尾块移入外置 `.img` 镜像，支持 `.nxpart` 前台自动合片），新增或更新游戏可直接热推送或导出 `DmGame.framework` 放入 `Documents/Frameworks`（侧载用户可在手机壳导入 `.p12` 证书自动完成本机签名），免重装壳 IPA，支持 **10 种界面语言** - **持久化构建种子与批量快刷**：`1.5` 构建自动留存 `build-seeds`，大多数后续引擎升级几分钟即可批量快刷，无需保留原始游戏包或 `_build` 目录，配套游戏专属更新版本角标（如 `1.5`）与三向缺失 `.img` 恢复。Windows 启动器（`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`）同步支持通用多游戏批量构建队列（`BuildQueue`）、最高 2 GiB 动态模拟堆与应用内自更新（`NX2Apple.exe`） - **快捷指令画中画引导、后台音频混音与手柄操控**：iPhone 与 iPad 内置 6 步添加到主屏幕向导（带画中画悬浮跟做卡片）与连手柄自动启动，支持与其他应用音频同时播放（`DM_AUDIO_MIX`）、`16:9` 交互式封面裁剪、可视化触控布局编辑器、蓝牙双 Joy-Con 横握拆分及单只横握方向映射，以及 Steam Controller（2026） - **208 款游戏配置，含 19 款 Switch 2 游戏**：在 Mac 或 Windows 启动器直接选择 Switch 2 游戏文件夹或 `.nup` 文件，无需 `prod.keys`，Mac、iOS 与 Windows 三端均支持任天堂商店横幅兜底 所有版本见[更新日志](CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。
--- ## 这是什么 NX2Apple 用你自己导出的游戏文件，在你的 Mac 和 iPhone 上运行 Nintendo Switch 游戏。它不是模拟器： 游戏自己的代码直接在 Apple 芯片上运行，由 Metal 负责绘制。一个 Mac App（启动器）点几下就完成构建 （解包、改写、翻译 shader、打包），然后把你的游戏放进游戏库，像 Switch 一样点 **Play** 启动。 它是 **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** 的社区 fork。真正的工作（代码改写器、Horizon 宿主层、NVN-on-Metal 和每个游戏的 profile）都是 nxnative 的，本 fork 在其上增加启动器和少量补丁， 并每天跟随 nxnative 更新。 ## 环境要求 - **Apple Silicon Mac。** 启动器支持 **macOS 13 或更新**。构建需要装了 iOS SDK 的 Xcode，NVN 游戏需要 [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/download/all/?q=Xcode%2027.2) 27.2（macOS 26.6 或更新），除非加 `--allow-other-metal`。 请从 Apple 的下载页面获取 27.2，而不是 App Store 里更新的 Xcode。如果同时安装了两个版本，可以把 27.2 改名为 `Xcode-27.2.app`。在**设置 → 工具 → 选择 Xcode…** 中选择 NX2Apple 使用的 Xcode，也可以选择外置硬盘上的副本。 首次启动时，可先点**稍后设置**退出向导，选好 Xcode 后在设置页点**再次运行设置**。点**使用系统 Xcode** 可让启动器使用 Mac 的命令行工具设置（例如通过 `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode-27.2.app` 选择的副本）。 - **你自己的游戏文件**（NSP 或 XCI）和**你自己主机里导出的 `prod.keys`**。本项目不自带、不下载、 也不替你查找任何东西。一份 `prod.keys` 能解你所有的 Switch 游戏。新导出的一份覆盖所有零售游戏。 Switch 2 游戏（游戏文件夹或 `.nup` 文件）不需要 `prod.keys`。 - 要装到 iPhone 或 iPad：iOS 或 iPadOS 26 或更新，以及较新的设备。更旧的设备未测试。 App 自带构建工具和 Python，不需要装 Homebrew 和 Python。默认的 `nxnative` 引擎和原生引擎 `nxkit` 都不需要 .NET，只有 S2Arm 引擎需要，App 会一键帮它安装 .NET SDK。启动器的依赖页会逐项检查，能装的一键安装。 ## 安装 1. **下载 App**：从[最新版本](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/releases/latest)下载 `NX2Apple-macOS-arm64.zip`，解压。 2. **首次启动：右键 → 打开。** 这个 App 没有付费的 Apple 开发者证书签名，所以 macOS 在第一次启动时会 询问，之后就能正常打开。 3. **按设置页走。** 启动器会取回构建用的项目（设置页上的「下载仓库」按钮，浅克隆到 `~/NX2Apple`， GitHub 不顺手时页面会给出手动 ZIP 的路线），检查上面的工具，之后还会自己更新。全程不需要懂 git。 4. **构建游戏。** 选好游戏文件夹（或者分别选本体、更新包、DLC 和 `prod.keys`），选择「这台 Mac」或 「iPhone / iPad」，按构建。页面显示真实的阶段和剩余时间，中途停止的构建会从上次继续。「iPhone / iPad」 是装在设备上、容纳你所有游戏的一个共用 App。启动器用 Xcode 为它签名、安装并拷入游戏，需要一台与这台 Mac 配对的设备。 在终端里手动构建见 [BUILDING.zh-CN.md](BUILDING.zh-CN.md)。 **更新已构建的游戏。** 由 `1.5` 构建的游戏在本地留存构建种子，同步引擎改进时直接点**刷新**或**批量刷新**即可分钟级完成更新，无需保留原版 NSP/XCI 或 `_build` 目录。安装游戏本身的新版更新包 NSP 时仍走完整**重新构建**：在游戏库中选中游戏，保留已选的游戏本体，在「更新和附加内容」中选择新的更新包，并在原输出文件夹中构建。更新可能同时改动游戏代码和数据，启动器会构建新版本并尽量复用缓存。存档按游戏的标题 ID 保存在 `.app` 外的独立文件夹中，在同一游戏库中重新构建或刷新都会保留原有进度。 ## iPhone 和 iPad 上的 App 「iPhone / iPad」目标会构建一个共用的外壳 App，和 Mac 启动器一样容纳你所有的游戏。游戏库用封面展示每个游戏。 竖屏时是单列，选中的游戏在顶部。横过来是 Cover Flow。iPad 显示网格。 - **从 Mac 添加游戏。** 用「iPhone / iPad」目标构建游戏，启动器会把它拷进 App。也可以直接导出独立的 `DmGame.framework` 放入「文件 > 我的 iPhone > NX2Apple > Frameworks」，无需重装共享壳 App（侧载用户可在手机端 App 的设置中导入 `.p12` 签名证书，让未签名框架在设备上自动完成本机签名）。重新签名和重装 App 都会保留游戏数据和存档。 - **游玩。** 选一个游戏，点 **Play**。缺少游戏数据或需要更新 App 的游戏，会在它的卡片上说明并给出解决办法。 - **每个游戏的设置。** 设置按钮（手柄上按 X）打开该游戏的启动选项。**重置**会把所有选择恢复为默认。 - **主屏幕快捷指令与画中画引导。** 内置 6 步**添加到主屏幕**向导（附可选画中画悬浮跟做卡片），支持创建 `nx2apple://launch` 桌面图标以及连接手柄时自动启动。 - **与其他音频同时播放。** 开启**与其他音频同时播放**（`DM_AUDIO_MIX`），游玩时可继续流畅播放音乐或播客。 - **更换封面。** 通过**更换封面…**选取自定义图片，并用 `16:9` 交互式双指缩放拖拽裁剪器调整画面。 - **手柄或键盘。** 整个 App 都能用手柄操作：方向键和摇杆移动，A 选择，B 返回，X 打开设置，Y 列出手柄。外接键盘的用法相同。 - **游戏数据文件夹。** 每个游戏可以从你在「文件」App 里选的文件夹（例如外置硬盘）读取数据，也可以用 App 自己的文件夹。 - **云存档。** 为游戏选一个 iCloud Drive 文件夹，存档就和 Mac 保持同步。 - **语言。** App 跟随系统语言，支持全部 **10 种语言**（英语、简体中文、瑞典语、德语、法语、意大利语、西班牙语、日语、韩语和巴西葡萄牙语）。 App 需要 iOS 或 iPadOS 26 或更新。封面是 Mac 启动器为你自己的游戏缓存的 eShop 横幅。 ## 游玩 **在 Mac 上**，构建好的游戏带着封面出现在游戏库里，点 **Play** 启动。**启动选项**（按游戏保存，重新 构建后仍然保留）可设置帧率、主机模式（底座或掌机）、渲染缩放和超分辨率、游戏语言、操控等，每项的 作用见 [docs/settings.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/settings.md)（英文）。手柄既能操作游戏，也能操作启动器。 **在 iPhone 上**，App 在游戏开始前显示同样的设置，点 **Play** 即可。触屏操控有 2D 和 3D 两种布局 （点顶部中央的按钮切换），连接手柄（Xbox、PlayStation、Switch Pro、MFi）后触屏控件会隐藏。 触屏、震动和体感见 [docs/playing.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/playing.md)（英文）。新场景第一次出现时短促卡顿是正常的： App 会为它编译一次图形并记住。游戏数据（`romfs.img`）可以放在外置硬盘上，用「文件」App 选取。 **游戏语言。** 默认英文。Mac 上用启动选项里的「游戏语言」一行（`1.5` 新增波兰语与泰语选项）。面板里没有的设置，可以写一个 `env.txt`，每行 `KEY=VALUE`（例如 `DM_LANG=zh-Hans`），放在两处之一： `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative//env.txt` 优先，重新构建后仍在， `<App>.app/Contents/Resources/dm/env.txt` 是 App 自带的。在加入语言选项之前构建的 Mac App 需要重新构建 一次才有该项。iPhone 上同样的行写在 `Documents/env.txt` 里（`DM_FPS_TARGET=30` 限帧省电， `DM_OPMODE=0` 选掌机模式）。该文件对共享 App 里的每个游戏都生效。只属于某一个游戏的行（例如 mod 的 `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`）写在 `Documents/games/<title ID>/env.txt` 里。两个文件设置了同一个键时，以该游戏的文件为准。 Mod 更简单：把它的文件夹放进 `Documents/games/<title ID>/mods/<mod 名>/`（RomFS 文件放在其中的 `romfs/` 文件夹里，或直接放在该文件夹里）。之后 Shell 只为这个游戏设置 `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`。有多个 mod 时，替换同一文件的 情况下按名称排在前面的生效。同一个键被多处设置时的优先顺序：Shell 自己的设置、该游戏的 `env.txt`、该游戏的 `mods/` 文件夹、共享的 `Documents/env.txt`。 **存档和日志。** 放在游戏库文件夹里的 Mac 游戏，存档和日志在 App 旁边（`log/<title ID>.log`），否则在 `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative/<title ID>/` 和 `~/Library/Logs/nxnative/<title ID>.log`。 iPhone 上在「文件」App 里该 App 名字下：`save/` 和 `log.txt`（上一次运行的是 `log.prev.txt`）。 **报告问题。** 启动器问题和构建问题请用[问题表单](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues/new/choose)（构建问题、 启动器问题）。表单会要你填版本和电脑、**设置 > 复制诊断信息**，构建问题还要填构建日志。 为什么需要见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)（英文）。游戏崩溃、卡死、变慢或画面不对，请提到 [seedds/nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/issues)。 千万不要附上密钥、游戏文件或任何从游戏中提取的内容。 ## 游戏 共有 208 个游戏 profile。部分游戏上游报告 iPhone 可玩，其余的 profile 还没在手机上试过。其中几款： | | 游戏 | 运行于 | 状态 | |---|---|---|---| | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 塞尔达传说：王国之泪 | Mac 和 iPhone | **本 fork 验证**：304,243 个文件，逐字节校验，约 17 GB | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/hades-ii.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Hades II | Mac 和 iPhone | **本 fork 验证** | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/animal-crossing-new-horizons.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 集合啦！动物森友会 | iPhone | **本 fork 验证**：流畅运行 | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/super-mario-odyssey.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 超级马力欧 奥德赛 | iPhone | 上游报告可玩 | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/zelda-breath-of-the-wild.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 塞尔达传说：旷野之息 | iPhone | 上游报告可玩，1.9.0 可 60 fps | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/images/mario-kart-8-deluxe.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 马力欧卡丁车 8 豪华版 | iPhone | 上游报告可玩 | **[GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md)**（带截图图库和每款的安装大小） 有完整表格和每款游戏需要的更新包版本：更新包 NSP 的显示版本必须与 profile 一致，否则构建会提示。 **Switch 2 游戏**已在引擎中支持，目前共有 19 款游戏拥有 profile：Donkey Kong Bananza、 Splatoon Raiders、Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave、Pokémon Pokopia、Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment、 Mario Kart World、Mario Tennis Fever、Star Fox、Yoshi and the Mysterious Book、The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time、 Kirby Air Riders、Super Mario Bros. Wonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park、 Orbitals、Fast Fusion、Resident Evil 4、Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour、Nintendo Switch Sports Resort、 Sonic Frontiers Definitive Edition 和 PRAGMATA。在构建页面选择游戏文件夹（`base/`、`updates/`、`dlc/`）或它的 `.nup` 文件即可，不需要 `prod.keys`。游戏库会把它们标为 **Switch 2**。除了 Donkey Kong Bananza 已在 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 上验证之外，《The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time》Switch 2 版已在 Mac 上完整通关至演职员表，《Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave》也已在 iPhone 上以 60 fps 验证运行。详情见 [GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md#switch-2-游戏)。 ## 限制 - **只支持有 profile 的游戏。** 列表之外的游戏需要单独的 bring-up 工作，起点是 [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/agents/README.md)（上游为其他 Switch 游戏写的指南，英文）。 - **大体积游戏在 iPhone 上会碰到内存上限。** 没有 Increased Memory Limit entitlement 时 iOS 只给 App 约 3.4 GB，不够《王国之泪》用。App 请求了它，AltStore Classic 2.2+、Impactor 和 Xcode + Personal Team 会保留，SideStore 配合免费 Apple ID 需要对 App ID 做一次性修复，Sideloadly 会丢掉它 （[步骤](ENTITLEMENTS.md)）。完整的测量见 [GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md#验证情况)。 - **启动器未签名。** 启动器不会替你签名，需要你自己侧载。iPhone 上的 App 在启动器安装时由 Xcode 用你自己的团队签名。 - **你自己的文件。** 不包含也不下载任何游戏数据、固件或密钥。 - **旧的分片归档不再被读取。** 最早的 iPhone 构建把《王国之泪》打成 RomFS 分片归档（`romfs.idx`），现在 构建写出单个 `romfs.img`。仍保留旧归档的 iPhone 需要通过启动器把游戏数据重新发送一次（`romfs.img`）。 ## 给开发者 - **从源码构建：** [BUILDING.zh-CN.md](BUILDING.zh-CN.md)。**报告或修复问题：** [CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)。 - **哪里需要帮忙：** [里程碑](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/milestones)就是计划，怎么从中认领一个 issue 见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#where-we-would-love-help)。 - **本 fork 对上游改了什么：** 引擎（`dm/`、`scripts/`、`docs/`、`ref/`）不提交在本仓库里。它是 nxnative 在固定提交（`.upstream-ref`）上的内容，加一组补丁，每个补丁写明本 fork 为什么带着它， `python3 tools/engine.py sync` 把它构建到 `engine/`。见 [patches/README.md](patches/README.md)。 `python3 tools/engine.py status` 列出带着的全部补丁。每天一次的任务移动固定提交并开 pull request， 某个补丁对不上时开一个点名该补丁的 issue。本页指向引擎文档的链接都指向 nxnative 的固定提交。 - **其他 Switch 游戏：** [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/b680dbb9e925ffd122027dce2cf201653ab8a03d/docs/agents/README.md)（解包、二进制调查、bring-up）。 - **版本历史：** [CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md](CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。 ## 致谢 **社区贡献者** —— 这个项目的代码不只是一个维护者的输出： -
